queries: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(p.procgpu * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

WITH per_site AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) t GROUP BY entrystat

responses.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(p.procgpu * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: Rows with proccpu = 0 are treated as having a missing GPU/CPU ratio (division guarded with NULLIF) and are skipped in the ratio average, though they still count toward the RAM average.
Sites with a NULL entrystat form their own group, shown with a NULL access status.

responses.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: Rows with proccpu = 0 are treated as missing for the ratio (NULLIF avoids division by zero); rows with NULL procgpu or proccpu are ignored by AVG.
Ratio is computed per run (procgpu/proccpu) and then averaged per site, using floating-point division rather than integer division.
Sites with NULL entrystat form their own group (a NULL access status row), since the request does not say to exclude them.

responses.sql: SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) t GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per processing run (procgpu / proccpu, as a real number rather than integer division) and then averaged; runs with NULL procgpu or NULL/zero proccpu are ignored for the ratio average.
Zero proccpu is treated as a missing ratio (via NULLIF) to avoid division by zero.
A site with a NULL entrystat forms its own group, and the outer query returns it as a NULL access-status row.
